+/*

+Set Ansi_Nulls On

+Go

+(
+	@RegisterDormID bigint = null,
+	@AreaID nvarchar(50) = null,
+	@DormID nvarchar(50) = null,
+	@DormBedID nvarchar(50) = null,

+	Set Nocount On;
+	Select
+		SIM_RegisterDorm.RegisterDormID,
+		SIM_RegisterDorm.StudentID,
+		SIM_Student.StudentCode,
+		SIM_Student.StudentFirstName,
+		SIM_Student.StudentLastName,

+			When Isnull(SIM_Student.LiveAddress, N'') <> N'' and GEN_LiveProvince.ProvinceName is null Then SIM_Student.LiveAddress
+			When Isnull(SIM_Student.LiveAddress, N'') = N'' Then N''

+		Case When GEN_LiveWard.WardName is not null Then GEN_LiveWard.WardName + N', ' Else N'' End +

+		Inner Join SIM_Dorm on SIM_Dorm.DormID = SIM_DormBed.DormID
+		Inner Join SIM_Area on SIM_Area.AreaID = SIM_Dorm.AreaID
+		Inner Join SIM_Student on SIM_Student.StudentID = SIM_RegisterDorm.StudentID

+		Left Join GEN_Province GEN_LiveProvince on GEN_LiveProvince.ProvinceID = SIM_Student.LiveProvinceID
